name: Datanla Falls
summary: Walk down to Datanla Falls on Prenn Pass. Visit Lâm Đồng prints 07:00 to 17:00, about 60 minutes, and 30,000 VND to enter. Operator pages print higher bundles for the alpine coaster and canyoning. Buy the entrance if you only wanted the falls.

notice.title: The entrance is not the coaster
notice.body: Visit Lâm Đồng prints 30,000 VND to enter. Operator pages print higher bundles when the ticket adds the alpine coaster or canyoning. Ask which one you are buying.

body: Datanla is the waterfall on Prenn Pass, south of town. The walk to the cascade is the visit. Vietnam Tourism also names canyoning here, with a guide, as a separate activity. The alpine coaster is the other add-on.

Visit Lâm Đồng prints 07:00 to 17:00, about 60 minutes, and 30,000 VND entrance. Operator pages print higher bundles once the coaster or canyoning is included. If you only wanted the falls, buy the entrance. The taxi over the pass has no printed minutes. Check on arrival.

figures.caption: The cascade at Datanla
figures.alt: Water falling at Datanla Falls on Prenn Pass

gettingThere: The falls are on Prenn Pass, south of the centre. Take a taxi from Xuan Huong Lake. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Taxi over Prenn Pass. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed.
admissionNote: Visit Lâm Đồng: 30,000 VND entrance, open 07:00 to 17:00, about 60 minutes. Operator pages print higher bundles for the coaster and canyoning. The higher figures are not collapsed into the entrance price. Confirm at the gate.
